description: Source code for URL and HTML escaping functions in the hoedown library, including character safety tables and escape functions.

methods.name: hoedown_escape_href
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in a URL href, converting unsafe characters to %XX and handling special cases like '&' and '''.

methods.name: hoedown_escape_html
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in HTML, converting special characters to HTML entities, with optional secure mode for '/' character.
